title: Shield Potion (Fortnite)
blurb: Glug, glug, glug, while being actively shot at. Fortnite's shield potion takes five full seconds to drink, which turns every use into a gamble — you are trading time for survivability at the worst possible moment — and the sound became one of the most recognisable in modern gaming purely through repetition. It has since doubled as the internet's official audio for chugging anything at all. Play it while drinking, before walking into a difficult conversation, or any time you would benefit from fifty extra shield and cannot obtain it.
origin: The shield-potion drinking sound from Fortnite.
